title: Speaking Confidence Trend After Tutor Sessions
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:tutor language=* confidence_score=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(confidence_score) as metric by _time language
| sort 0 _time language
description: Trends monthly confidence score by language for speaking practice.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether speaking practice are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `language` on `language:tutor` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly confidence score.
visualization: Line chart of monthly confidence score by language.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how confidence score changes month by month for each language so you can see whether speaking practice are heading the right way.
